newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FTC to meet, no subject disclosed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FTC to meet, no subject disclosed.

text.p: The Federal Trade Commission will meet at 2 p.m. EST (1900 GMT) today, it was announced.
No subject was disclosed for the closed meeting.
Recent controversial cases before the FTC have included a proposed merger between Staples and Office Depot .
The hastily-called meeting of the five commissioners follows by one day a final agreement between the two office superstores to divest 63 stores to the third player in the field, OfficeMax.
That final deal was made in an effort to overcome earlier objections of the commissioners to the proposed deal. This month they voted 4-1 to turn down the proposed merger.
But FTC Chairman Robert Pitofsky said last week that the deal was potentially "fixable."
"Is it fixable?" he said at the time. "Yeah, it's fixable. I'm really just speculating here."
At the time, he said he had not seen a final proposal by the stores to change the deal.
With the agreement Wednesday, the stores now have a new offer to show the commissioners.
